title: GPU particles and compatibility crash on latest Google pixel
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.5

### System information

Android 16 - Pixel 10

### Issue description

GPU 3d particles are causing a crash on the Pixel 10 with the compatibility renderer.

It crashes in ``submodules/godot/drivers/gles3/storage/particles_storage.cpp`` at method ``glDrawArrays(GL_POINTS, 0, p_particles->amount);`` on line 782 

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/1cf31805370716ce8160ddc1394b9820249a21f7/drivers/gles3/storage/particles_storage.cpp#L782-L782

The callstack is:

<details>
<summary>Click to expand callstack</summary>

```

GLES3::ParticlesStorage::_particles_process(GLES3::ParticlesStorage::Particles *, double) particles_storage.cpp:782
GLES3::ParticlesStorage::update_particles() particles_storage.cpp:1129
RenderingServerDefault::_draw(bool, double) rendering_server_default.cpp:90
Main::iteration() main.cpp:4829
OS_Android::main_loop_iterate(bool *) os_android.cpp:364
Java_org_godotengine_godot_GodotLib_step(JNIEnv *, jclass) java_godot_lib_jni.cpp:312
```

</details>
